key_rules: 3% per trade, max 12 positions, daily loss limit −20%

v5.2 exits (new trades): SL -15%, TP0 +20% sells a third, trailing stop 15% below the peak after +20%, TP1 +40% sells half + breakeven, TP2 +100%, cut after 4h if still below 0%, 48h time stop (older trades keep SL -25% / TP1 / TP2)
Pool age 1–1440h; socials required if the token is under 7 days old
Organic and copycat filters auto-FAIL; mint/freeze/honeypot/RugCheck danger still hard-FAIL
Re-entry cooldown 2h after a full exit (paper, rules v6.3-copy)

v5.1 override: at most 2 soft gates may miss within margin (liq ≥ $15,000, vol24 ≥ $35,000, vol1h ≥ $3,000, age 0.75–1584h, BSR 0.75–4.5, score ≥ 45) if score ≥ 65 (or ≥ 60 plus a quality top-trader/copy signal still held). PASS required when liquidity is bent; size 2% then. Hard safety and the $15k floor never bend.

v6 Helpers: Risk Manager up-only sizer (base 3% / 2% liq-bent floor, scales up to 6% on strong checks), News Checker advisory (+confirmed-rug RSS veto), Scout watchlist + auto-approve if v5/v5.1 qualified (entry_source=scout_auto)
Shadow helpers (log only, never change trades): Entry Timer (enter now / wait / skip) and Exit Manager (dynamic stops, partial TPs, trailing, time and momentum cuts vs the v5.2 exits)

v6.3-copy: a copyable top-trader buy or 2+ watched wallets buying (still holding, < 6h) is paper-copied automatically (entry_source=copy) if hard safety passes and liquidity ≥ $15k; size 3% (2% under $20k liquidity) plus the Risk Manager tiers; v5 soft gates are bypassed for copies
